blocks.text: Social change for the better happens when groups of citizens try to
bring it about. Today, such groups can take on many tasks once
performed by governments. These so-called non-governmental
organizations deliver social services. They are active in various areas
from law to medicine. They watch and influence what government do at
home or abroad. What is more, they often work better than
